raw:
1. That the plaintiff seeks leave of this Hon’ble Court to withdraw the suit filed herein, pursuant to Order XXIII Rule 1 CPC.

2. That the plaintiff further seeks permission to institute a fresh suit on the same cause of action, as allowed under Order IX Rule 4 CPC, subject to the law of limitation.

3. That the plaintiff undertakes to pay any costs that may be awarded against him and to comply with any further directions of this Court.

PRAYER

The plaintiff prays that this Hon’ble Court may be pleased to:

a) Grant leave to withdraw the suit under Order XXIII Rule 1 CPC;

b) Permit the plaintiff to file a fresh suit on the same cause of action under Order IX Rule 4 CPC; and

c) Pass such further order(s) as may be deemed fit.
